200.description: The document passed every check; the compiled form, the step report and the read-side projection.

definition.description: The compiled form the engine runs, which is what the typed steps compiled to.

steps.description: Each authored step's compiled steps and where its ports lead.

compiledStepNames.description: The compiled steps the authored step produced, in order.

name.description: The port name, as the step type declares it.

when.description: Condition under which this arm is taken; absent for the unconditional arm.

target.description: The authored step the arm leads to.

workflow.description: The same read-side projection the workflow read route serves for a stored revision.

name.description: The display label the workflow is known by: for a stored workflow, the root `name` its highest stored version declares; for a compiled document, its own. Null when none does.
name.example: EU B2C individual KYC — EEA, applicant chooses the document

initialStep.description: The step every onboarding of this workflow starts on.

scores.description: Every score the workflow declares, keyed by score name, with the bounds it is clamped to.

webhook.description: The state-change webhook the workflow declares, or null when it declares none.

path.description: Path the state-change webhook is delivered to.

status.description: Where an onboarding stands. `awaiting_user` and `awaiting_manual_review` are live; `approved`, `rejected` and `invalid` are terminal.

allOf.description: Where an onboarding stands. `awaiting_user` and `awaiting_manual_review` are live; `approved`, `rejected` and `invalid` are terminal.
allOf.title: WorkflowStatus

terminal.description: True for a step the onboarding ends in.

status.description: The transition status this arm handles, such as `success`, `rejected` or `manual.approve`.

target.description: Step this transition moves to, or null for a transition that re-enters its own step.

when.description: Condition guarding the transition, or null when it always applies.

allOf.description: A condition in normalized form: a combinator over other conditions, a comparison of a score, or a test of a submitted field.
allOf.title: WorkflowCondition

reason.description: Refusal reasons this arm claims, or null when it claims any. Without it two `rejected` arms to different targets are indistinguishable to a reader.

items.description: Why a connector refused the step's data: the caller exhausted its attempts, the challenge expired or was never issued, or the provider rejected outright.
items.title: ConnectorRejectionReason

source.description: The authored step this one compiled from, or null when no report was available.

type.description: The authored step type, such as `otp-verify` or `custom`.

category.description: The step type category, such as `collect` or `terminal`.

type.description: The field type name, such as `text`, `file` or `boolean`.

persist.description: False when the accepted value is validated but not stored.

when.description: Condition that makes the field apply, or null when it always does.

allOf.description: A condition in normalized form: a combinator over other conditions, a comparison of a score, or a test of a submitted field.
allOf.title: WorkflowCondition

schema.description: JSON Schema for this field's value, as the state endpoint serves it.

upload.description: What the document upload routes accept for an upload field, otherwise null.

maxImageWidth.description: Present for image fields that bound width.

maxImageHeight.description: Present for image fields that bound height.

type.description: A connector's capability class: the axis a workflow's connector declaration and a step type's connector slot are matched on.

allOf.description: A connector's capability class: the axis a workflow's connector declaration and a step type's connector slot are matched on.
allOf.title: ConnectorType

canReject.description: Whether the connector may refuse the step.

fieldMapping.description: Required connector inputs, mapped to the context field that fills each.

optionalFieldMapping.description: Optional connector inputs, mapped to the context field that fills each.

authoredId.description: The connector id the workflow document authored. Differs from `id` while an operator selection is in force.

selected.description: True when an operator selection replaces the authored connector on this step, in every stored version of the workflow that has the step.

selectableIds.description: The connector ids a selection on this step would be accepted with, for this version, sorted: the authored and effective ids, plus every registered connector that passes the same rules the write applies — same `type`, callback-capable for an asynchronous step, every one of its callback fields declared by the step, its own declaration rules satisfied, and not already a fallback here. Empty when the step declares no connector or more than one, since no selection can address it.

fallbacks.description: The chain behind this connector, in declared order.

type.description: A connector's capability class: the axis a workflow's connector declaration and a step type's connector slot are matched on.

allOf.description: A connector's capability class: the axis a workflow's connector declaration and a step type's connector slot are matched on.
allOf.title: ConnectorType

canReject.description: Whether the connector may refuse the step.

fieldMapping.description: Required connector inputs, mapped to the context field that fills each.

optionalFieldMapping.description: Optional connector inputs, mapped to the context field that fills each.

400.description:
`WORKFLOW_INVALID`: The document fails the DDL; `reason` names the rule and `path`, when the failure can be located, the offending place.

`WORKFLOW_CONNECTOR_DECLARATION_INVALID`: A step's connector declaration is refused by the adapter it names; carries `stepName` and the adapter's `detail`.

allOf.description: The engine's own error envelope. `code` is the stable identifier a client branches on; `message` repeats it. A code that adds detail properties is described on the operation that returns it.
allOf.title: ApiError

401.description: No bearer token, or the token fails signature, issuer, audience or expiry verification.

schema.description: NestJS's default error envelope, returned where the framework answers instead of the engine: request validation (`400`, `message` lists each violated rule), the admin bearer guard (`401`, `403`, `503`), and a `500` on the submit and provider-callback routes where a connector adapter fails with a plain error rather than a coded refusal.
schema.title: NestHttpError

403.description: The token verifies but its `roles` claim holds none of `ADMIN_REQUIRED_ROLES`; signing in again cannot fix this.

schema.description: NestJS's default error envelope, returned where the framework answers instead of the engine: request validation (`400`, `message` lists each violated rule), the admin bearer guard (`401`, `403`, `503`), and a `500` on the submit and provider-callback routes where a connector adapter fails with a plain error rather than a coded refusal.
schema.title: NestHttpError

409.description: `WORKFLOW_SOURCE_KEY_CONFLICT`: Another stored workflow already owns this source key; carries `sourceKey` and `conflictingWorkflowId`.

allOf.description: The engine's own error envelope. `code` is the stable identifier a client branches on; `message` repeats it. A code that adds detail properties is described on the operation that returns it.
allOf.title: ApiError

503.description: Entra's signing key set could not be reached, so the token was never judged. Retry.

schema.title: NestHttpError
